info.title: TruckConnect Auth API
info.description:
Authentication, authorization, and organization management API for the TruckConnect Philippine freight platform.

TruckConnect Auth provides a complete identity and access management solution for freight logistics companies in the Philippines. It handles user authentication, organization management, role-based access control, API key provisioning, and webhook event delivery.

## Authentication Methods

TruckConnect Auth supports two authentication methods:

### Session Cookie
After signing in via `/api/auth/sign-in/email`, a `better-auth.session_token` cookie is set automatically. This is the primary method for browser-based applications.

### Bearer Token
For service-to-service communication, use the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. The token can be:
- A **JWT access token** obtained from `/api/auth/token` (short-lived, for microservice calls)
- A **TruckConnect API key** (`tc_live_*` format, for long-lived integrations)

## Rate Limiting
All endpoints enforce rate limits. When exceeded, the API returns `429 Too Many Requests` with `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers. Limits vary by endpoint and are documented per-operation.

## Error Responses
All errors follow a consistent format with an `error` string field. Some endpoints return a `code` + `message` pair for machine-readable error handling.

## Organization Types
TruckConnect supports multiple organization types: `tc_platform`, `enterprise_shipper`, `msme_shipper`, `carrier_fleet`, `freight_forwarder`, `warehouse_operator`.

cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie automatically set after sign-in via `/api/auth/sign-in/email`. The cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax. Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity.

bearerAuth.description:
Bearer token authentication. Accepts either:
- **JWT access token** from `/api/auth/token` (RS256, 15-minute expiry)
- **TruckConnect API key** in `tc_live_*` format (long-lived, org-scoped)

image.description: Avatar URL hosted on Cloudflare R2

metadata.description: Organization metadata including type and configuration

prefix.description: First 16 characters of the key for identification

plaintext.description: The full API key. Shown ONCE at creation time, never stored. Save this immediately.

message.example: The email or password you entered is incorrect

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the rate limit resets

description.example: Full-service carrier fleet operating across Luzon

role.description: The user's role within this organization

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current window

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the rate limit window resets

post.summary: Register a new account with email and password
post.description:
Creates a new user account and establishes a session. The password must pass TruckConnect's password policy:
- Minimum 8 characters
- At least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character
- Not found in the Have I Been Pwned breach database

A verification email is sent automatically after successful registration.

200.description: Account created successfully. A session cookie is set and a verification email is sent.

400.description: Validation error -- weak password, missing fields, or invalid email format

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (5 requests/minute per IP)

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password credentials. On success, sets a session cookie and returns the user profile. Failed attempts are tracked for security monitoring.

200.description: Signed in successfully. A `better-auth.session_token` cookie is set.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 requests/minute per IP)

post.summary: Sign out and invalidate current session
post.description: Clears the session cookie and invalidates the session server-side. The session token can no longer be used for authentication after this call.

200.description: Signed out successfully. Session cookie cleared.

get.summary: Get the current session and user
get.description: Returns the current session and user data if authenticated. Returns `null` if no valid session exists. This endpoint is the primary way for client applications to check authentication state.

200.description: Session data (or null if not authenticated)

post.description: Sends a password reset link to the provided email address. Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists, to prevent email enumeration attacks. The reset link expires after 1 hour.

redirectTo.description: URL to redirect to after reset (must be an allowed origin)

200.description: Reset email sent (or silently ignored if email not found)

post.summary: Reset password using a reset token
post.description: Completes the password reset flow using the token received via email. The token is single-use and expires after 1 hour. The new password must meet TruckConnect's password policy.

token.description: Reset token from the email link

200.description: Password reset successfully. All existing sessions are invalidated.

400.description: Invalid or expired token, or password doesn't meet policy

post.description: Changes the password for the authenticated user. Requires the current password for verification. The new password must meet TruckConnect's password policy. All other sessions are invalidated after a successful change for security.

newPassword.description: The new password (must meet password policy)

200.description: Password changed successfully. Other sessions invalidated.

400.description: New password doesn't meet policy requirements

401.description: Not authenticated or current password is incorrect

post.summary: Validate a password against TruckConnect policy
post.description: Checks a password against TruckConnect's password rules (length, complexity, common passwords) and the Have I Been Pwned breach database. Use this for real-time password strength feedback during sign-up or password change forms.
Sends a 6-digit one-time password via SMS to the user's phone number for verification. The OTP expires after 10 minutes. Requires an active session.

phoneNumber.description: E.164 format phone number (Philippine numbers start with +63)

400.description: Invalid phone number format

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (max 3 OTPs per 10 minutes)

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code and marks the phone number as verified on the user's account. The OTP is single-use and expires after 10 minutes.

400.description: Invalid or expired OTP

get.summary: Get a JWT access token for the current session
get.description: Exchanges the session cookie for a short-lived JWT access token (RS256, 15-minute expiry). Used by client applications to authenticate with other TruckConnect microservices. The JWT contains the user ID, email, role, and active organization context in its claims.

token.description: Signed RS256 JWT access token (15-minute expiry)

get.description: Returns the public keys used to verify JWT tokens issued by TruckConnect Auth. Other microservices should cache this response and use it to validate tokens without contacting the auth server on every request. Keys are rotated periodically.

200.description: JWKS containing public keys for JWT verification

kid.description: Key ID for matching against JWT header

post.description: Signs out all sessions except the current one. Useful when a user suspects unauthorized access to their account. Returns the count of sessions that were revoked.

get.description:
Returns the current user's trusted and untrusted metadata. super_admin can read any user's metadata by passing `?userId=xxx`.

- **trustedMetadata**: Server-controlled data, only writable by super_admin (e.g., KYC status, account tier)
- **untrustedMetadata**: User-controlled data, writable by the user themselves (e.g., preferences, UI settings)

Maximum 64 KB per metadata field.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Target user ID (super_admin only, defaults to self)

403.description: Cannot read another user's metadata (requires super_admin)

patch.description:
Merges top-level keys into the user's metadata. Send `null` for a key value to delete that key. super_admin can update any user via `?userId=xxx`.

- **untrusted**: Writable by the user themselves
- **trusted**: Only writable by super_admin

Maximum 64 KB per metadata field. Nesting limited to 4 levels deep.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Target user ID (super_admin only, defaults to self)

trusted.description: Trusted metadata fields to merge (super_admin only)

400.description: Invalid JSON body or metadata exceeds 64 KB limit

403.description: Cannot write trusted metadata (requires super_admin) or cannot update another user

get.description: Returns all active (non-expired) sessions for the current user, including device type (parsed from User-Agent), IP address, and whether it is the current session. Useful for building a "manage sessions" UI.

delete.description: Revokes a specific session by ID. Cannot revoke the current session (use sign-out instead). Only the session owner can revoke their own sessions.

sessionId.description: ID of the session to revoke

400.description: Missing sessionId or attempting to revoke current session

post.description:
Uploads a new avatar image for the current user. The image is stored on Cloudflare R2 and the previous avatar is automatically deleted.

**Constraints:**
- Max file size: 4 MB
- Allowed types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF
- Magic bytes are validated against declared MIME type
- Minimum dimensions: 50x50 pixels

avatar.description: Image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF, max 4 MB)

400.description: Invalid file (wrong type, too large, too small, or magic bytes mismatch)

delete.description: Deletes the current user's avatar from R2 storage and sets `user.image` to null.

post.description:
Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated data. This action is irreversible.

**What gets deleted:**
- User profile and metadata
- All active sessions
- Avatar from R2 storage
- Organization memberships (user is removed from all orgs)
- Owned organizations are transferred or deleted based on member count

Requires password confirmation for security.

confirmation.description: Must be the string 'DELETE MY ACCOUNT'

400.description: Missing confirmation string or confirmation does not match

401.description: Not authenticated or password is incorrect

get.description: Returns all organizations the current user belongs to, along with their role in each organization. This is a convenience endpoint that provides a simplified view compared to `/api/auth/organization/list`.

200.description: List of organizations the user belongs to

post.description: Creates a new organization and makes the current user the owner. The slug must be unique across all organizations and will be used in URLs.

400.description: Validation error (duplicate slug, missing fields)

get.summary: List organizations the current user belongs to
get.description: Returns all organizations where the current user is a member, along with their role in each. Includes organization metadata such as business type.

200.description: List of organizations with membership info

post.summary: Invite a user to an organization by email
post.description: Sends an email invitation to join the organization. The invitation includes a link that allows the recipient to accept or reject. Requires org admin role (owner, admin, enterprise_admin, carrier_owner, shipper_admin, or forwarder_admin).

email.description: Email of the user to invite

400.description: Invalid input

post.description: Accepts a pending invitation and adds the user as a member of the organization with the role specified in the invitation.

invitationId.description: The invitation ID from the invite email

200.description: Invitation accepted, user is now a member

400.description: Invalid or expired invitation

post.description: Rejects a pending invitation. The invitation status is set to 'rejected' and cannot be accepted later.

400.description: Invalid or already handled invitation

get.description: Returns details about a specific invitation, including the organization name, inviter email, assigned role, and current status.

post.summary: Remove a member from an organization
post.description: Removes a member from the organization. Requires org admin role. Cannot remove the organization owner -- ownership must be transferred first.

memberId.description: The member record ID (not the user ID)

400.description: Cannot remove the owner

post.summary: Update a member's role in an organization
post.description: Changes the role of a member within an organization. Requires org admin role. Available roles vary by organization type.

400.description: Invalid role

post.description:
Submits or updates the organization's marketplace profile for the TruckConnect marketplace directory. This profile is used to list the organization in the marketplace where shippers can discover carriers, forwarders, and warehouse operators.

Requires org admin role. The profile enters a `pending` state for review by TruckConnect platform admins before being published.

businessName.description: Business name as it should appear in the marketplace

serviceAreas.description: Philippine regions where the organization operates

description.example: Full-service carrier fleet operating across Luzon with 50+ trucks

400.description: Validation error (missing required fields, invalid business type)

post.description:
Validates a `tc_live_*` API key and returns the associated organization context and permissions. This endpoint is called by other TruckConnect microservices to authenticate incoming API requests.

**Security features:**
- Timing-safe comparison with a 50ms minimum response floor to prevent enumeration attacks
- Automatic key usage tracking (`lastUsedAt` timestamp updated)

The key can be provided via the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header or in the JSON body as `{ "key": "..." }`.

key.description: The API key (alternative to Authorization header)

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token with the API key

200.description: Key is valid -- returns organization context and permissions

401.description: Key is invalid, revoked, or expired

get.summary: List API keys for an organization
get.description: Returns all API keys for the organization. Does not include plaintext keys (only the prefix for identification). Requires org admin role (owner, admin, enterprise_admin, carrier_owner, shipper_admin, forwarder_admin) or super_admin.

post.summary: Create a new API key for an organization
post.description:
Generates a new `tc_live_*` API key. The plaintext key is returned **ONCE** in the response and is never stored -- save it immediately.

**Limits:** Maximum 50 active keys per organization.

Requires org admin role.

name.description: A descriptive label for the key

expiresInDays.description: Number of days until the key expires (optional, defaults to no expiry)

201.description: API key created. Save the `plaintext` value immediately -- it cannot be retrieved again.

400.description: Validation error (name too long, invalid expiresInDays, or 50 key limit reached)

delete.description: Soft-deletes an API key by setting its `revokedAt` timestamp. The key will immediately stop working for authentication. This action cannot be undone. Requires org admin role.

404.description: Key not found in this organization

get.summary: List invite codes for an organization
get.description: Returns all invite codes (active and revoked) for the organization. Requires org admin role.

post.summary: Create an invite code for an organization
post.description:
Generates a shareable invite code that others can use to join the organization. Maximum 50 codes per organization.

**Code format:** 8 alphanumeric characters (no ambiguous chars like O/0/I/1). You can optionally provide a custom code.

**Valid roles:** owner, admin, member, enterprise_admin, carrier_owner, shipper_admin, forwarder_admin, dispatcher, driver, finance, viewer.

role.description: The role assigned to users who redeem this code

maxUses.description: Maximum number of times the code can be used (null for unlimited)

expiresInDays.description: Number of days until the code expires

code.description: Custom code (optional, auto-generated if not provided)

400.description: Validation error (invalid role, code format, etc.)

429.description: Maximum 50 invite codes per organization reached

delete.description:
Soft-deletes an invite code by setting its `revokedAt` timestamp. The code will immediately stop working. Requires org admin role.

Pass the invite code's `id` in the request body.

id.description: The invite code record ID to revoke

400.description: Missing id

404.description: Code not found in this organization

get.summary: Preview an invite code (no auth required)
get.description: Returns public information about an invite code: the organization name, the role it grants, remaining spots, and expiration. Does not require authentication. Useful for showing a preview before the user signs in or signs up.

spotsLeft.description: Remaining uses, or null if unlimited

400.description: Missing code parameter

410.description: Code is revoked, expired, or has reached its usage limit

post.summary: Redeem an invite code to join an organization
post.description: Uses an invite code to add the authenticated user as a member of the associated organization. Atomically increments the usage counter to prevent race conditions past `maxUses`.

400.description: Missing code

409.description: User is already a member of this organization

410.description: Code is revoked, expired, or has reached its usage limit

get.description: Returns all registered webhook endpoints including their event subscriptions and active status. Requires super_admin role.

post.description:
Creates a new webhook endpoint. Events will be delivered via POST with HMAC-SHA256 signatures in the `X-Signature-256` header. Requires super_admin role.

**Supported events:**
- `user.created`, `user.updated`, `user.deleted`
- `session.created`, `session.revoked`
- `organization.created`, `organization.updated`
- `member.added`, `member.removed`, `member.role_changed`
- `invitation.created`, `invitation.accepted`
- `api_key.created`, `api_key.revoked`

url.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook events

events.description: List of event types to subscribe to

201.description: Webhook endpoint created. The signing secret is returned ONCE -- save it immediately.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Save this immediately -- it cannot be retrieved again.

400.description: Invalid URL or unknown event types

delete.description: Removes a webhook endpoint and all its pending event deliveries. This action is irreversible. Requires super_admin role.

patch.description: Updates the URL, events, active status, or description of a webhook endpoint. Only the fields provided will be updated. Requires super_admin role.

post.description: Returns a paginated list of all users on the platform. Supports searching by name or email, sorting, and pagination. Only accessible to users with the `super_admin` role.

search.description: Search by name or email (case-insensitive partial match)

total.description: Total number of users matching the query

post.summary: Set a user's platform role (super_admin only)
post.description: Changes a user's platform-level role. Use this to promote a user to `super_admin` or demote them back to `user`. Cannot change your own role.
Bans a user, preventing them from signing in. All active sessions are immediately invalidated. An optional reason can be provided for audit purposes.

reason.description: Optional reason for the ban (stored for audit trail)

200.description: User banned and all sessions invalidated

post.description: Lifts a ban on a user, allowing them to sign in again. The user will need to create a new session.
